what: On first open the white logo card (front) stands for .45s, then flips 180° on the Y axis over 1.1s power1.inOut to become the score card (back) — it stands on its edge for about 1s and the back settles in decelerating. Starting .28s after the flip begins, the back number counts up from 0 to its value over 1.4s quad out, the tick arc is drawn along with it and the handle dot follows the arc end. When everything has settled, fx:done fires

options.delay: Seconds the front face stays upright, default .45
options.at: Delay before counting starts after the flip begins (s), default .28
options.on: Document event name — if given, starts on receiving that signal (chain after the loader)
options.[data-fx-part=front]: Front face (logo card) — laid flush over the panel
options.[data-fx-part=back]: Back face (end screen) — only this shows when there is no script or motion is reduced
options.[data-fx-part=num]: Counting number slot, end value is data-to (read from the text if absent) — if there are several, they count together
options.[data-fx-part=arc]: (Optional) SVG path drawn along with it
options.[data-fx-part=knob]: (Optional) SVG circle that follows the arc end

note: Parts attach after DOMContentLoaded, so the back face may flash briefly on first paint. If it must be the front face from first paint <head> Early on, put a marker on html (e.g. lv-js of app-video-card-landing) and apply the is-fx-flip rule in fx.css once more under that marker. Numbers are printed as rounded integers

from.where: about.html .fs-flip (original Brand score page hero — a white logo card flips into a 95% score card, counting up 76→95, timed against a filmstrip)
